subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should the Copilot BYOK local proxy enforce a hard 16 MiB request-body cap and 30s read timeout for existing BYOK provider requests?
rationale: The code repair is clear, but the accepted payload and read-time envelope for existing Copilot BYOK users is a compatibility/product-security contract choice.

options.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
options.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended local BYOK proxy limit now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection are covered.

options.title: Adjust the envelope before merge
options.body: Change the constants if maintainers expect legitimate BYOK SDK/provider requests above 16 MiB or longer than 30 seconds.

options.title: Pause for payload confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until the expected Copilot BYOK request-size envelope is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
recommendation.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended local BYOK proxy limit now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection are covered.

likelyOwner.reason: The BYOK proxy appears to originate in vincentkoc's Copilot BYOK provider parity work, making that history the strongest routing signal for the contract decision.
